item.title: Design AI for My Community: A Case Study of Collaborative Learning in a Freedom-to-Read Summer Camp
item.description: Case study from ICLS 2025: a summer camp themed “Protect the Freedom to READ” where middle school students co-designed AI for their community, transferring AI literacy into higher-order skills through critical pedagogy and embodied learning tools.
